method.generators: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/invariants/generators.ts - seeded (mulberry32) Song Models: any key, four modes, diatonic triads/sevenths with occasional borrowed chords, meters 4/4 3/4 6/8 5/4 7/8, tempi 56-176, 2-9 sections (English / Hebrew / unnamed), with or without vocal phrases and an energy curve; every model passes validateCanonicalSongModel and evaluateArrangementEligibility (60/60). Mutations: transpose, retime, rename, shuffle sections, remove family, swap instrument, reseed.
method.checks: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/invariants/analysis.ts - pure checkers returning violations; every invariant has a negative control (a deliberately broken input the checker rejects) in its suite.
method.knownFailures: An invariant the brain fails today runs under node:test `{ todo }` with the observed behaviour in the reason; the assertion is unchanged.
method.seedPolicy: fixed seeds per suite (1..24, 100.., 200.., ...); every failure is reproducible by seed; 20-24 seeds per invariant, 200 for the fuzz
method.path: orchestrateArrangement with the reference composer, contextAware off, render off, candidateCount 2-3

causesIsolated.finding: FAMILY_WORDS has no 'key'/'piano', so a keys or piano part in the RHYTHMIC_HARMONY role resolves to the drum-kit definition (kitByRhythm fires on the role): composed into 36-60 with four voices, performed with ghost notes and a flam, would be routed to a kit.
causesIsolated.evidence: definition-family: 8/24 seeds; determinism-different-seed seed 609; probe (a): keys/RHYTHMIC_HARMONY -> drums 35-81, piano/RHYTHMIC_HARMONY -> drums
causesIsolated.fix: resolve by the planner family first (or add key/piano/organ/rhodes to FAMILY_WORDS)

causesIsolated.finding: The composer's bar is numerator x (60/bpm): in 6/8 and 7/8 that is twice the Song Model's bar, so a 128 s song is written over 255 s - every harmony part goes silent from the second or third section on, the drums (chord-independent) keep going, intro/ending/transition tasks find no chord in their window and write a literal C-major [0,4,7] (line 266), and the drum accents fall on the wrong eighths.
causesIsolated.evidence: meter-6-8 0/20, meter-7-8 0/20; empty-parts 89 silent pairs in x/8 (seed 903: last note at 255 s of 128 s); transposition pitch_not_transposed only on 6/8 and 7/8 seeds
causesIsolated.fix: beatSeconds = (60/bpm) x 4/denominator as canonicalTimeline and benchmarkCorpus do; better, use the Song Model's bars[]

causesIsolated.finding: Math.round(span / beatSeconds) for bass steps, comping hits and ostinato steps sits on a .5 knife edge whenever a chord spans an odd number of half-beats (half-bar harmonic rhythm in 3/4, any chord in x/8); the count flips with the tempo's floating-point residue.
causesIsolated.evidence: tempo: seed 21 bass 204 -> 142, guitar 635 -> 439; seed 20 bass 54 -> 33 with byte-identical plans, densities and budgets (probe 3)
causesIsolated.fix: count steps on the canonical tick grid or round with an epsilon

causesIsolated.finding: A chord whose end exceeds the next section's start by a float epsilon is included in that section's window and written as a minimum-duration stub of the previous harmony on the downbeat, with the same position-based id as the new chord's voice.
causesIsolated.evidence: fuzz: 6/200 models with duplicate note ids (seed 2094: guitar c22.55-0 = p58 d2.62 and p65 d0.08)
causesIsolated.fix: exclude chords overlapping the window by less than a fraction of a beat; make ids unique per (task, chord index, voice)

causesIsolated.finding: The quietest-voice tie is broken on pitch, so which member of a legal chord is dropped depends on the key; the shipped voicing is not transposition-invariant.
causesIsolated.evidence: transposition voice_choice_changed on 10/24 seeds (raw composer output transposes exactly: 0 wrong pitches over 2,289 notes in probe 2)
causesIsolated.fix: a musical rule (keep root and third, drop the doubling) independent of absolute pitch

causesIsolated.finding: When an untouched track carries two notes with one id (C4), the restore rewrites the first duplicate with the second; outsideScopePreserved is correctly false.
causesIsolated.fix: restore by position, or assert unique ids at the boundary

causesIsolated.evidence: meter-3-4: kick on beat 1 in 75-83 % of bars on 4/20 seeds; meter-5-4 2/20
causesIsolated.fix: the audit's F7: texture archetypes, not stride deletion

causesIsolated.finding: One drum cell (kick 1 and 3, snare 2 and 4) for every numerator: 5/4 gets a 4/4 backbeat with beat 5 dead; 3/4 gets kick 1 and 3 with snare 2.
English regular expressions: Hebrew and unnamed sections are all 'neutral'.
causesIsolated.evidence: section-naming 0/20 (hebrew) and 0/20 (unnamed): 99 functions changed, climax layer lost in 19/20 seeds, intro/ending tasks dropped, fewer transition devices
causesIsolated.fix: classify by form position / repetition / energy, with a multilingual name table as one input

causesIsolated.finding: LEAD in a non-instrumental section returns no task (the audit's F5).
causesIsolated.evidence: empty-parts: 10 silent LEAD pairs; the isolated test 902

causesIsolated.finding: Playable random pitches (chord-tone share 0.9 -> 0.3) move the score by -2..+2 on 15/20 seeds; drums-only outscores the full arrangement on 10/20 seeds; the 36-point drop under unconstrained random pitches is the playability hard rule.

causesIsolated.file: musicalConstraints.ts vs musicProviders.ts validateCanonicalTrackModels vs playabilityRepair.ts
causesIsolated.finding: Three playability definitions: the contract accepts every shipped candidate (0 errors), the engine refuses guitar beds whose sustained chords lap the next (impossible_fingering, 9 errors in 6/72 candidates) and piano cluster voicings after a keys->guitar swap (7); playabilityRepair counts any overlap as a second voice where the other two allow 30 ms of legato.
causesIsolated.evidence: playability-shipped validatorDisagreements; instrument-swap validatorDisagreements; the documented-disagreement controls

causesIsolated.finding: floor/ceil window edges: an energy array aligned one sample per bar changed a section's energy by 0.09 under a pure retime (probe 1). The generator now writes an offset grid; not asserted.
causesIsolated.fix: sample by bar centres or interpolate

causesIsolated.finding: Brass/strings accents pick the chord sounding at a bar start by float boundary equality, so a retime changes their pitches.
causesIsolated.evidence: tempo seeds 2, 10, 16 pitch_content_changed on climax layers
causesIsolated.fix: look up chords with a tolerance

honestLimits: Everything is measured on the reference-composer path with the context passes off and rendering off; the audio critic, the native renderers and the job runner are untested here.

20-24 fixed seeds per invariant and 200 fuzz models; not exhaustive. The generator writes diatonic triads/sevenths with occasional borrowed chords, one tempo and one meter per song, no slash chords, no modulation, at most 96 bars.
Transposition allows whole-octave folds (8,661 over 75,195 matched notes) and chord-roll/strum shifts under 40 ms (2,690); both are reported, not failed.
The tempo invariant stays inside one tempo band (the style fingerprint's own reading); a retime across bands legitimately changes the plan and is not measured.
Metre checks judge kick, snare and hat placement; 3/4 passes a 'kick 1 and 3, snare 2' cell that is not a waltz. Compound-metre hat accents are measured on performed velocities.
Critic sanity uses one candidate per seed; the playable random-pitch mutation keeps the hard rule on most seeds (recorded per seed as playableRandomFeasible).
Golden digests describe the current output; drift is reported, never blocked (B-00 pins its own byte-identical golden).
Section-naming invariance is measured on treatment (functions, families, roles, tasks, notes per family, transition devices), not on audio.
The owner's fixture ran once with candidateCount 3 for its digest; its arrangement was not judged here.
No production module was changed; every known failure is recorded, none fixed. Nobody has listened.
